text: He looks at that Cautus, so inferior to the Sarkaz. He looks at the Black Crown, such a meaningless curse.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe history and illusions he trampled on, the bloodline and inheritance, the revenge and unrivaled power, all suddenly disappear.",block = true)]
text: \nThe history and illusions he trampled on, the bloodline and inheritance, the revenge and unrivaled power, all suddenly disappear.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="He feels a void beneath his feet.", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=720,block = true)]
text: He feels a void beneath his feet.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="A figure in white falls from the skeleton.", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=720,block = true)]
text: A figure in white falls from the skeleton.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]Ridiculous... even the myriad souls mock me.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: Ridiculous... even the myriad souls mock me.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]Lord of the Banshees, and... King of Sarkaz.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: Lord of the Banshees, and... King of Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]You keep these deserters around who ignore the past, and in the end, you don't even dare to act yourselves.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: You keep these deserters around who ignore the past, and in the end, you don't even dare to act yourselves.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]Oh... the vile always prevail.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: Oh... the vile always prevail.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]This is indeed our curse.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: This is indeed our curse.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]The outblood King has executed me?
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: The outblood King has executed me?

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]The King of Sarkaz resounds with the knells. But you don't know how strong the ties of blood are. You try to judge...
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: The King of Sarkaz resounds with the knells. But you don't know how strong the ties of blood are. You try to judge...

speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: You—

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]Heh, in the end, you did use the power within your blood!
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: Heh, in the end, you did use the power within your blood!

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]Two elegiac singers offered me a dirge at the same time—
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: Two elegiac singers offered me a dirge at the same time—

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]When the time came, you could not resist the instinct within your blood that comprises all that you are.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: When the time came, you could not resist the instinct within your blood that comprises all that you are.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]Did you really kill me? No.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: Did you really kill me? No.

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]I have returned the Teekaz blood to where it belongs...
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: I have returned the Teekaz blood to where it belongs...

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"]Go and see, go to Londinium—
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: Go and see, go to Londinium—

raw: [name="Sanguinarch of Vampires"](Whispered Sarkaz) I'll be waiting for you behind the curtain of ruin.
speaker: Sanguinarch of Vampires
content: (Whispered Sarkaz) I'll be waiting for you behind the curtain of ruin.
